entities.name: Pentti Niinivuori
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pentti Niinivuori was a Finnish boxer. He competed at the 1952 Summer Olympics and the 1956 Summer Olympics. At the 1952 Summer Olympics, he lost to Sergio Caprari of Italy.
